decision_rule: RUNS_AGREE if the dry run finished and |Performance ns/day - wall-clock ns/day| / wall-clock ns/day <= 0.05, the wall-clock from date stamps written just before and just after the timed run; RUNS_DISAGREE otherwise, and every later ns/day then carries 'Performance line and wall-clock disagree'; RUNS_TIMING_NOT_READ if the timing output is degenerate; REFUSED if an error line names centroid/stress/atom, stress/atom, heat/flux or the GPU pair style (run a is then not run); FAILED for any other error, which stops the run; STOPPED if the guard's deadline ended it.
metric: timed dry run: Performance-line ns/day of the 1,000 timed steps against 1000 x 2e-6 ns / (wall seconds / 86400); runs or refused; units from in.init
